item.title: Call for Special Issue Proposals
item.content:encoded:
This is a call for special issue proposals for the journal Computers in Human Behavior. Interested scholars are invited to submit proposals for special issues that address the intersection of computers and human behavior.

Appel publié par Computers in Human Behavior. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
